      <title>Lithic: Senior Software Engineer, Product Platform</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for the Product Platform team, which owns the foundational layer of our API that all other Lithic products build on top. The team’s mission is to make Lithic's API the best in fintech — reliable, consistent, and a joy to integrate with. This includes API Gateway, Events Platform, API key management and authorization, audit logging, or API norms and versioning strategy.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Write reliable, secure, and scalable code for Lithic's product platform with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Own projects from planning to launch, spanning areas like API key management, reliability, audit logging, or search, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>4+ years building production backend systems, ideally including public-facing APIs at scale</li>
<li>Experience in or desire to learn Rust; ability to understand Lithic’s system written in other programming languages (Python, Java)</li>
<li>Interest and experience in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity</li>
<li>Ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse perspectives, and drive toward practical solutions</li>
<li>Experience with API design fundamentals and product thinking: versioning, backward compatibility, schema-driven development, and weighing tradeoffs from the customer's perspective</li>
<li>Comfort with designing systems from scratch and owning the product development process end-to-end</li>
<li>Strong written communication skills and experience working in a remote, async-first team that’s spread across time zones</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>

</div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Benefits for Full-Time US Employees:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited PTO</li>
<li>12-weeks fully paid parental leave</li>
<li>4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary)</li>
<li>Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year</li>
<li>3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary <a href="http://Privacy.com">Privacy.com</a> employee account</li>
<li>Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match</li>
<li>401(k) match</li>
<li>Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD</li>
</ul>
<p>NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.</p>
<p>In-office employees receive:&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>Commuter benefit</li>
<li>Catered lunch every Tuesday and Thursday</li>
</ul></div>

      <title>Tebra: Senior Benefits Administrator</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@<a class="c-link" href="http://tebra.com/">tebra.com</a>, @<a class="c-link" href="http://patientpop.com/">patientpop.com</a>, or @<a class="c-link" href="http://kareo.com/">kareo.com</a>) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse.&nbsp;We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.</p></div><h1>About the Role</h1>
<p>We are seeking an experienced and analytical Senior Benefits Administrator to oversee the day-to-day administration and strategic alignment of our health and welfare plans. Reporting directly to the HR Operations Director, this role plays a pivotal part in managing our self-insured medical plan, monitoring plan performance, managing Third-Party Administrator (TPA) relationships, and ensuring compliance across all health and welfare offerings (medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401K and wellness).</p>
<p>The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in ERISA, HIPAA, and ACA compliance, strong data analytics capabilities to evaluate claim trends, and exceptional employee communication skills to deliver a seamless experience.</p>
<h1>Your Area of Focus</h1>
<h3><strong>Self-Insured Plan Oversight &amp; Financial Management</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Claims Analysis &amp; Tracking: Monitor ongoing medical and prescription drug claims performance; identify trends, high-cost claimants, and cost-driver patterns in partnership with plan actuaries and brokers.</li>
<li>Stop-Loss Administration: Coordinate stop-loss policy renewals, track claims reaching individual/aggregate stop-loss thresholds, and submit reimbursement filings to carriers.</li>
<li>TPA &amp; Vendor Governance: Oversee relationships with Third-Party Administrators (TPAs), Pharmacy Benefit Managers (PBMs), and Benefits broker and carriers. Ensure operational execution according to SLAs.</li>
<li>Funding &amp; Reconciliations: Partner with Payroll and Accounting to manage weekly/monthly billing, claims funding requests, reserve requirements (IBNR tracking), and employee contribution and invoice reconciliations.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Health &amp; Welfare Plan Administration</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Open Enrollment: Lead the annual Open Enrollment process, including system updates, open enrollment communications, employee informational sessions, and post-enrollment audits.</li>
<li>Life Events &amp; Ongoing Administration: Manage day-to-day enrollment changes, qualifying life events (QLEs), dependent eligibility verifications, and COBRA processing.</li>
<li>Disability &amp; Leave Coordination: Support short-term/long-term disability programs and align benefit premiums during active FMLA/LOA periods.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Compliance &amp; Governance</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Regulatory Reporting: Ensure strict compliance with federal and state regulations, including ERISA, ACA (1094/1095 reporting), HIPAA, COBRA, and FMLA.</li>
<li>Plan Documentation: Maintain updated Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), Summaries of Benefits and Coverage (SBCs), Plan Documents, and Form 5500 filings.</li>
<li>Nondiscrimination Testing: Coordinate annual 105(h) and Section 125 nondiscrimination testing with third-party compliance specialists.</li>
<li>Annual Benefits Audits: Lead annual 401K audit and execute dependent eligibility and enrollment audits throughout the year.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Employee Experience &amp; Communications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Escalated Claims Support: Act as the primary point of contact for complex, escalated employee claims issues, serving as an advocate while maintaining plan governance.</li>
<li>Benefits Communication: Draft clear, accessible employee communications explaining self-insured plan features, cost-saving tools (e.g., telehealth, centers of excellence), and wellness incentive initiatives.</li>
</ul>
<h1>Your Professional Qualifications</h1>
<h3><strong>Education &amp; Experience</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).</li>
<li>5 years of direct experience dedicated to health &amp; welfare plan administration.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience managing self-insured / self-funded medical plans, including working with stop-loss insurance, TPAs, and PBMs.</li>
<li>Professional Certifications (Preferred): CEBS (Certified Employee Benefit Specialist), SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP, or PHR/SPHR.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Technical &amp; Analytical Skills</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>HRIS Proficiency: Experience administering benefits using Workday.</li>
<li>Data &amp; Excel Mastery: Advanced skills in MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data modeling) to analyze large sets of claims and census data.</li>
<li>Regulatory Depth: Deep functional knowledge of ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, and IRS Section 125 rules.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>#LI-SS1 #LI-Remote</strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions.</p>
<p>Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this:<br>Zone 1: National Average<br>Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions<br>Zone 3: High-Cost Regions<br>Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions</p>
<p>Beyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during your initial talent screen.</p></div><div class="title">Zone 1 (National Average)</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$90,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$103,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>About Tebra</h1>
<p>Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="http://www.tebra.com/">www.tebra.com</a>.</p>
<h1>Our Values</h1>
<h2>Start with the Customer&nbsp;</h2>
<p>We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens.</p>
<h2>Keep It Simple</h2>
<p>Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone.</p>
<h2>Stay Entrepreneurial&nbsp;</h2>
<p>We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action.</p>
<h2>Better Together</h2>
<p>We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together.</p>
<h2>Celebrate Success</h2>
<p>Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success.</p>
<h1>Perks &amp; Benefits&nbsp;</h1>
<p>United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.</p>
<p>Costa Rica: To assist with all of life’s needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.</p>
<h1>Compliance &amp; Privacy Disclosures</h1>
<p><em><span>NOTE: Tebra is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here: <a href="https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/">https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/</a></span></em></p>
<p><em><span>If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="mailto:talentacquisition@tebra.com">talentacquisition@tebra.com</a>&nbsp;and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too.</span></em></p>
<p></p>
<p><em>As part of our commitment to a fair and efficient hiring process, Tebra utilizes Greenhouse Notetaker, Greenhouse's native interview intelligence tool, for our phone and video screenings. This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your interview may be recorded.</em></p>
<p></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tebra-senior-benefits-administrator">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tebra-senior-benefits-administrator</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Mercury: AML Investigator III</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
</p>

<p>Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify entrepreneurs' and business owners’ financial lives.The challenge is to do so while ensuring we protect Mercury, customers and the broader financial ecosystem from bad actors and harmful, illegal or unauthorized activities.</p>
<p>Our AML Investigations team is crucial in this mission and is responsible for detecting suspicious activity, conducting thorough investigations, and shutting down bad actors. This team is growing and we’re looking to hire an additional AML Risk Investigator to help us with Bank Partner Requests for Information, Transaction Monitoring, Financial Crime Investigations, Case Management and drafting Unusual Activity Reports. As a member of our Investigations team, you’ll help handle our transaction monitoring queues while balancing an eagle eye for risk with excellent user experience. To begin with, you’ll work to help make sure we have smart, risk-based monitoring in place and help build out our case management technology and processes.</p>
<p>You’ll need to learn how a really wide range of businesses work and bring your knowledge to bear on our processes and product. Some of this work is repetitive and requires close attention to detail, so we need someone who loves working fraud and anti-money laundering transaction queues and managing a variety of complex investigations.</p>
<p><em>*</em><em>Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.</em></p>
<h3><strong>As part of the journey, we would expect you to:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Provide input as we implement new transaction monitoring rules and tune existing ones</li>
<li>Review AML, and other financial crime alerts in our transaction monitoring queue and take action as needed</li>
<li>Contact our users for information on their account usage and transactions</li>
<li>Work with our partners and internal team members to review and assess information received from users</li>
<li>Investigate and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs) from our Partner Banks, delivering clear, well-supported AML reviews on customer’s account activity</li>
<li>Decision user accounts as needed, including locking or closing accounts</li>
<li>Develop an understanding of expected activity for each type of user we work with</li>
<li>Document investigative findings and escalate unusual or potentially suspicious activity to our Partners for SAR consideration</li>
<li>Develop an unfailing eye for potential fraud or money laundering</li>
<li>Investigate tools that would make your job easier&nbsp;</li>
<li>Write clear documentation on current processes and help train future teammates</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Have experience in identifying money laundering, detecting fraud, or other financial crimes related behavior in banking, fintech, or other financial services through vendor AND in-house developed transaction monitoring rules&nbsp;</li>
<li>Be fluent in the language of bank transactions, including ACH, check, debit card, credit card, and wire transfers, both domestic and international</li>
<li>Understand the business banking landscape and have familiarity with international activity and ownership</li>
<li>Exercise empathy and understanding when communicating with users</li>
<li>Communicate complicated concepts with efficiency and clarity, both in speech and writing</li>
<li>Manage relationships with external parties with confidence and kindness</li>
<li>Work with efficiency and focus</li>
<li>Understand how to keep an organized and clean inbox</li>
<li>Love problem solving and making teams, product, and processes more efficient</li>
<li>Derive joy from customer joy</li>
<li>Enjoy thinking about how to automate as much of your job as possible</li>
<li>Be curious about the US banking system, startups, and ecommerce companies</li>
</ul>
<p>Mercury values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</p>
<p>#LI-DNI</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong><br>The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.</p>
<p>Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.</p>
<p>Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following<strong>:</strong></p></div><div class="title">US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$121,700</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$152,100 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$109,500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$136,900 USD</span></div></div></div>
